result:
Round 488 passed and is published. Round 489 is planned and ready for A: **SABA-B-17**, Saba's request that the first-visit entrance animation last at least 3–4 seconds. The decision is **CONTINUE**.

**Backlog updated from round 488:** C passed it in the browser with no bugs and the gate published it as `73f994d`. C-R487-01 is closed. B-R486 (the Profile name editor) is done for the browser side only; the real save against the backend still can't be checked in the cloud. The new Lows from A's reviewer and the gate went to the deferred polish list. I asked root for a read-only frontend-architect checkpoint on `account.tsx` before round 491, because rounds 487, 488, 490 and 491 all change that one file.

**What I found measuring the current version:** the entrance lifts after about 1.6 s. Two related problems would get worse with a longer animation, so I folded both into round 489 as Mediums:
- **Slow first visit:** when the page's JS arrives more than 1 s late, the animation never plays. The visitor sees about 1.3 s of plain black, then the page.
- **Wheel under the cover:** scrolling during the animation moves the page 600 px without the visitor seeing it.

**Round 489 change (code written in advance as a patch for A to apply unchanged):**
- **Duration:** at least 3.5 s from the first black frame, at most 5 s on a slow machine. The logo is fully visible about 1.7 s (was 0.7) and the tagline about 1 s.
- **Slow JS:** the black cover now waits up to 2 s for the page's JS instead of 1 s. On 4G with a slow CPU, or with JS 0.8–1.5 s late, the animation now plays.
- **Skipping:** a wheel or touch scroll now skips it without moving the page. Zoom (Ctrl+wheel, pinch) also skips but is never blocked. Esc, Tab and click work as before.

**Testing:**
- Production builds of the current version and the patch were measured in Chromium across 25 scenarios each. C's pass limits are taken from those numbers.
- The full test suite passes on the patch: 293 files, 4292 tests.
- I made 22 deliberate breakages of the change, one at a time; each one made at least one of the new or updated tests fail.
- tech-lead: v1 came back with two required changes (zoom was blocked, the doc claimed too much), both fixed; v2 and the doc-only v3 were approved.
- I followed product-designer's recommendations (consulted twice) and gave each of its checks to C as an acceptance row.

**Still open:**
- **Fast 3G:** JS arrives about 2.3 s late, so the animation still doesn't play: the visitor sees about 2.3 s of black, then the page. Fixing that properly needs a static logo on the cover, which changes the look. That is Saba's call, so I re-asked it with this evidence.
- **Two new questions for Saba** (they don't block; defaults applied): whether scrolling should skip the animation (default yes, as built), and whether 2 s is the right wait on a slow connection. They are in `user-review/questions-saba-b-13.md`.
- **Recordings for Saba:** before/after videos are in `user-review/img/saba-b-17-entrance-*.webm`.
- **Real-device checks:** Saba's own feel check (fresh tab) and a touch check on a real phone are open as manual checks. They don't block; deadline is the round-495 retrospective.
- **Root issue:** the backlog cleanup script archives any finding whose status merely contains "done", "closed" or "resolved". That is how B-R486 was archived while it still said "not done". I checked every status I wrote this round and none are affected. The fix belongs to root.

The "why we missed it" lesson is merged into L18; `lessons.md` stays at 60 lines. Next: 490 is the 375 px Profile editor overflow, 491 the password modal. From 2026-11-16 a regression round comes first, and the retrospective is at round 495.

Files are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
